entry.title: Must Have Versus Nice To Have
entry.summary: Unlimited wants. Limited needs. Ever hear that? It's this idea that…
entry.content:
Unlimited wants.

Limited needs.

Ever hear that?

It's this idea that you really only need a few things.

But you want everything.

Or at least, that's the theory.

And that the less you truly need, the better.

And so you ask yourself, "Self, do I want this or do I need this?"

If the subject is oxygen, the answer is need.

If the subject is another product made by the fruit company, the answer is want.

Sometimes, needs feel like wants and wants feel like needs.

So what do you want that feels like a need?

And, more importantly, what is a need that feels like a want?

You will find that wants stack is voluminous.

Encyclopedic.

And that the needs stack is a pretty quick read.

A musings column.

I want you to understand the difference.

You need to.

entry.title: No Wizards
entry.summary: Do you want the truth or do you want the hope?…
entry.content:
Do you want the truth or do you want the hope?

Truth is we all got a finite timeline.

Walking this earth.

A begin date.

And a date with destiny.

Everything in between is life.

The hope is, then, that there's something that turns on when the lights go out.

That's the truth.

That's the hope.

The truth is, most folk don't want it.

The truth that is.

They think they do, but they really want the hope.

Truth is often nasty.

"You can't handle the truth!"

Dirty.

Filthy.

Horrific beyond conceivability.

"There are some books that are never meant to be read."

But truth can also be wondrous.

Magical.

The best beyond all belief.

Wuv. True wuv.

And that's the truth most want.

I hope.

And so, truth seekers, seek more hope.

And hope seekers, well, keep doing your thing.

The people who seek truth wear it on their flesh.

It's broken them, if they've sought it long enough.

But those who seek hope, glow.

The longer they've done it, the deeper the radiance.

I've turned more hope into truth, I still can't believe it.

It don't even make sense looking back.

I think I glow.

That's just the radiation and platinum in your body.

☢

That sheet just gave me a superpower.

Mutated to thankful.

Grateful.

Humble(ish).

So pay no attention to the man behind the curtain.

He's doing atrocious things to keep the world churning.

Same as it ever was.

Embrace the road.

Gold-bricked.

Ruby slippered.

With your people.

Follow it, and it will take you home.

Fowo you foeva.

I hope.

Hey, would you look at that.

You've had it with you all along.

👠

That's the gospel truth.

Click.

Click.

Boom.

Click.

"You used to be fun. You used to be warped and twisted and hilarious... and I mean that in the best way. I mean it as a compliment!"
"I was hilarious once, wasn't I?

entry.title: Thumbs Up
entry.summary: AI is moving fast. AI fast. The Answer! Remember when ai…
entry.content:
AI is moving fast.

AI fast.

The Answer!

Remember when ai couldn't do text in images?

Spelling things wrong in pictures.

So many six-fingered people Inigo looking at all of them funny.

It's flawless, now.

Somewhat.

What's staggering to me is how fast it's getting better.

And I'm not even on the cusp of this sheet.

I just play around with it when I want to.

And it's just noticeably better each time I pick it up.

Couldn't do that before.

Just bewildering what it can do with a little nudge.

I don't prompt.

I nudge.

[Nudging].

Now, with agents, you don't even have to be there.

I haven't gone that deep.

I want to be there.

I don't trust humans.

You think I'm going trust compute with a mission?

At the rate it's going though.

How soon before you trust it over humans.

How soon before it's better than most humans.

Uhh...

Are we already there?

It's already pretty fast.

Reliable.

Does good work.

Does it hallucinate?

Sure, who doesn't?

But it's less than it did before.

It's getting better.

After every iteration.

When the folks at the forefront of this literal machine are demanding we slow the eff down with all this running towards _______, it makes you wonder.

What are they seeing that we don't get to?

Bah.

I'm probably overreacting.

Like I am wont to do.

Underreact 99% of time.

Overreact 1%.

You mostly see the latter.

It's changing so fast.

We need to feed it more.

More compute now.

It's ravenous.

But, on the flip side, when I ask it something, it tells me.

No lip.

No delay (a few seconds).

And a good answer.

We're doomed.

Aww sheet.

Seen this movie before, y'all.

👍

entry.title: Fanatical
entry.summary: Nothing quite says summer's over like pro football. And here we…
entry.content:
Nothing quite says summer's over like pro football.

And here we go.

Summer's over.

Why?

Week one.

I no longer watch games live anymore.

For the most part.

I watch 'em in these wonderful little recap videos.

3 hours jammed into 15 minutes.

But I'll watch tonight.

I've always been a Harbaugh guy.

Not just the head coaches.

Their dad.

Their pops.

And his wisdom.

Summer was a blink.

Like all seasons.

A flash.

Autumn's my favorite season.

One of them.

I got three.

Maybe four.

Hard to love winter.

To one heck of a season.

And many more to come.

Stay healthy.

entry.title: Emergent
entry.summary: Psst. Hey you. Who me? Yeah. Get over here. Now, the…
entry.content:
Psst.

Hey you.

Who me?

Yeah.

Get over here.

Now, the first thing I gotta tell you is.

Never approach someone who "pssts" you.

But now that you're here, let's talk.

25 years ago, yesterday, something big happened.

What came with it was a lot of ugly.

A ton of it.

Foogly amounts.

The whole country shut down.

Sounds familiar.

In a bit of a haze.

I remember even sports shut down.

Hmm.

And when it finally reopened, I went to a Giants game.

They warned us to stay home.

Be safe.

It was the first since all of it happened.

And in the air was this mix of anger and patriotism.

A country united in rage.

People who looked a certain way wore red, white, and blue.

And people who looked another way stayed home.

You could, as Gorilla Monsoon would say:

"Cut the intensity with a knife!"

When the anthem was about to play, it got eerily quiet.

"Please rise."

Unnecessary because everyone was already standing.

You could hear your heartbeat.

"For the playing of our national anthem."

And when the music started, the entire stadium sang from their burals and bits.

Every mother mother in there sang the anthem.

Or so it seemed.

We weren't singing it half-heartedly and half-arsed either.

We sang full-hearted.

Full-arsed.

Only way to sing.

And when it was over.

The roar.

My God, the roar.

Still gives me goosebumps.

Deafening.

The stadium shook.

From the release of pent-up anger, confusion, rage, and pride.

But it was manifested as joy.

As glee.

As jubilance.

Sure, we all wanted blood.

But we would take camaraderie.

We would take celebration to mourn.

And we knew, we just knew, that revenge was coming.

In the form of a 100 foot tall pissed off bald eagle.

Now, looking back, I'm not sure if we got payback.

I'll leave that to you experts in vengeance.

But don't kill the moment.

Quarter century.

So much has changed.

What I choose to remember most, though.

Is a choir of 41,000 singing our nation's anthem.

United.

Through tears and strength.

Through song.

And the roar.

My God.

🇺🇸

Out of the ashes.

entry.title: I'm Going to Duel Him Lefthanded
entry.summary: There was this famous experiment. Maybe not so famous. But listen.
entry.content:
There was this famous experiment.

Maybe not so famous.

But listen.

I gotta point to make.

And it ain't on the top of your head!

It was an experiment in some class in some school somewhere in the world.

And the class was divided into two groups.

Each group had the same goal:

To make the best pot or something like that.

Details don't matter.

The first group had to spend all their time on making one pot.

The perfect pot.

The second had to make a pot a day for a month or however long it went.

And guess who won?

Second group.

The results showed that by iterating over and over again, you got a better pot.

More reps.

More bites.

More chances.

Sure, you make a lot of bad pots, but you get the best ones out of the batch, too.

And this is part of the problem with how we do things growing up.

Perfection is rewarded.

And usually for just one try.

You don't get to do-over papers and exams (typically).

Short-term memorization is the standard.

Regurgitate.

Spew.

100%.

This is a horrible way to get great at something.

Other than in regurgitation.

And spewing.

You'll fit right in here.

Of course.

When I was learning muay thai, it was obvious my front leg (left) was weak.

Now I had have monster hands.

Knees that would make my partner quit holding pads mid-round.

But front leg.

Was weak.

WEAK!

So I over-trained it.

Over-emphasized it.

It was a mission.

Learned to love that dang leg.

Turning weakness into something else.

Left side?

Strong side!

Something fun.

Soon, after many, many, reps, it became a strength.

A favorite.

Because it took work.

Because it was weak.

Because it cost time.

Because it got better.

Because I earned it.

If I only kicked once, it would suck. 

And it did.

No matter how much I planned the kick.

Of course, a left kick to the liver now would still put someone in the ER.

Me.

So iterating for me has changed.

The reps have changed.

Fingers.

My thumbs are going to be huge.

Musings.

Ideas.

But the model hasn't.

And it's one I learned late.

Like a lot of things.

Wissmart is often delayed.

But never denied.

God bless you all.

Most of you.

Work on your weaknesses.

Making failing fun.

And remember, you are the pot.

You get to make yourself every single day.

Every other day.

A week maybe.

The point is, you're the pot.

Have fun, left kicks.

entry.title: 'Til The Smoke Clears Out
entry.summary: I've talked before about Kintsugi. Beauty in the broken. This idea,…
entry.content:
I've talked before about Kintsugi.

Beauty in the broken.

This idea, or rather art, where you take something broken (like pottery or you) and turn it into something more beautiful.

In the pottery's case this is done by gluing it back together with glue made with gold.

Feature the scars. 

Don't hide them.

I don't know how we fix you.

I got gold glue here somewhere.

It's a wonderful idea.

One I resonate with.

But I recently learned of another.

Antifragile.

It's the worst name for the best idea I've heard in a long time.

The cursed double negative.

This idea that not only do you recover, better than ever, from what breaks you.

But that you flourish in the chaos.

During it.

That you prosper in the sheet.

"Were you in the sheet?"

"Yeah. I was in the sheet."

It reminds me of Rudy's poem:

If you can keep your head when all about you are losing theirs and blaming it on you.

Ooh, that one's good. 

If you can meet with Triumph and Disaster, and treat those two imposters just the same.

Man, that might be even better.

Or watch the things you gave your life to, broken, and stoop and build 'em up with worn out tools.

This is some of the best stuff.

I think Kippy had it.

The right idea.

Mindset.

I keep thinking of Hulk and Wolverine.

Stronger, strongest, in the fight.

During the fight.

Don't.

Just.

Survive.

Mother mother.

Win.

Force your heart, nerve, and sinew to serve your turn long after they are gone.

There are stories of men fighting wars who have had parts of their heads gone and yet, impossibly, still continue to fight.

They didn't know they were deed.

Because they simply did not allow it.

The fight must go on.

The fighter must, too.

Now, I hope you aren't at war.

Cabeza intact.

But there's no more time for the pity party you've been throwing.

It's time for a different kind of party.

Be that mother motherin' life form they find on some faraway (thought lifeless) planet.

How in the world is this thing still alive?

Hulk smash.

Nate, hit me.

🎤

Til the roof comes off, 

Til the lights go out

Til my leg give out

Can't shut my mouth.

...

I'ma rip this sheet

Til my bone collapse.

🦴

At your highest, when the roof comes off.

At your best, when the lights go out.

At your strongest, when your leg (singular) give out.

At your toughest, when the bone collapse.

Rip this sheet.

Snikt.

entry.title: Hang Up The Mudgeons
entry.summary: Reality checks sometimes bounce. Sometimes, they clear. There comes a time…
entry.content:
Reality checks sometimes bounce.

Sometimes, they clear.

There comes a time though.

When a curmudgeon's gotta hang up his mudgeons.

He's gotta just say thank you.

What is a mudgeon?

I learned a new term the other day.

One I've lived and live but never knew there was a term for.

PTG.

Post Traumatic Growth.

Focus on the G.

Something sheety happens.

And you transform.

Into something, into someone, better.

Like a mother motherin' snake doc.

Now, I ain't perfect.

But I kinda thought I was.

I kinda did.

You kinda did.

Boy, did I get a reckoning.

To the bone.

Humble pie was served.

That sheet came on a big sheet.

Here's the weird part.

The pie tasted good.

This is some good pie!

🥧

I needed it.

Sure, it made me skinny then fat(ish), took my muscles, made me age, but I am still here, y'all.

Still ticking.

No tocking.

I still walk around like old (young) me.

But I know that's just me fighting a ghost.

I want to tell you how great grateful I am, but it's hard to say.

What doesn't keel you, makes you stronger.

Embrace adversities.

Revel in chaos.

Embrace the suck.

That's a lot of hugging.

Now I'll be the first to tell you, I ain't gone through sheet compared to a lot of you.

But there's another way to go after the PT.

You don't have to go SD.

Don't stress disorder, learn to welcome it.

It has no idea who it's messing with.

Welcome to the Chungle.

Invite it in (it's coming in anyways, might as well welcome the beech).

And then serve it some pie.

🥧

You dirty mother...

Thank you.

You know where you are?

You're in the Chungle, baby.

You're gonna live.
